newsitem.title: UK: Cazenove Indian GDR Index down 0.54 percent.
newsitem.headline: Cazenove Indian GDR Index down 0.54 percent.

text.p: The Cazenove Indian GDR Index fell 0.43 points, 0.54 percent, to 79.87 after the Bombay Stock Exchange 30 share index rose 53.87 points, 1.60 percent, to a provisional 3,413.41.
The premium for GDRs over stocks on the local market was 19.81 percent.
The Cazenove index is a capitalisation weighted basket of Indian global depositary receipts and measures the change from midday on the previous trading day to midday today.
